title: Sprawl 15 Foundation
summary: A naturally ramping two-hour opening that teaches the complete field loop, carries every class to level 10, keeps Sol active as a visible combat partner until the capstone, and uses an authored level 5-8 survival shock with visible injury, recovery, and return to stable level 9-10 pressure.

chapters.title: Awakening & Partnership
chapters.summary: Build a character, define Sol’s formation order, cross the roof and caravan route, read the price of shelter, and recover disputed medicine.

chapters.title: Sprawl Systems
chapters.summary: Read evidence, secure water, and decide how survival infrastructure serves the district.

chapters.title: Trade, Repair & Truth
chapters.summary: Follow the protection economy, expose contradictions, and leave useful work with a traceable maker.

chapters.title: Class Identity in the Field
chapters.summary: Reconstruct the trial route, prepare witnesses and exits, then claim and rehearse one of fifteen class foundations.

chapters.title: Readiness & Second Life
chapters.summary: Apply class identity to a civic threat, complete the full patrol with Sol, reach level 10, rehearse your own method, and confront the truth beneath the Collector.

competencies.label: Navigate a connected district
competencies.description: Read exits, route across loops, and return to known places.

competencies.label: Command a combat partner
competencies.description: Choose Sol’s order and see him attack or intercept in live combat.

competencies.label: Recover and protect resources
competencies.description: Use medicine, health, and preparation rather than treating damage as disposable.

competencies.label: Read evidence in the environment
competencies.description: Search rooms, preserve records, and recognize contradictions.

competencies.label: Make an equivalent-weight choice
competencies.description: Resolve a resource conflict without a hidden superior reward.

competencies.label: Use the Sprawl economy
competencies.description: Connect salvage, facilities, repairs, credits, and maker accountability.

competencies.label: Use a signature technique
competencies.description: Apply the selected class foundation in a real encounter.

competencies.label: Read and modify field equipment
competencies.description: Compare tradeoffs, apply a traceable modification, and understand armor and recovery pressure.

competencies.label: Manage target, stance, defense, and pressure
competencies.description: Survive a multi-system encounter while Sol maintains the selected formation.

competencies.label: Complete the level 10 readiness circuit
competencies.description: Revisit the district, preserve the second route, and enter the capstone prepared.

bands.label: Guided foundation
bands.summary: Levels 1-4 remain forgiving while the player learns movement, Sol, recovery, evidence, and basic combat.

bands.label: Shock onset
bands.summary: Level 5 is the hardest impact: enemies press faster and harder while a reconstruction-line injury disrupts the player’s rhythm.

bands.label: Shock pressure
bands.summary: Level 6 keeps the danger high, but stabilization and field practice begin returning control to the player.

bands.label: Shock adaptation
bands.summary: Level 7 remains punishing, but learned class discipline and deliberate recovery now matter more than raw surprise.

bands.label: Shock endurance
bands.summary: Level 8 is still dangerous, but the injury is closing and the player should feel capable rather than helpless.

bands.label: Stabilized readiness
bands.summary: Levels 9-10 return to the authored average baseline so the final lessons test mastery rather than accumulated attrition.

injury.label: Reconstruction-line rib fracture
injury.summary: A scarred line beneath the left ribs tears under accumulated field strain. Sol recognizes the location as part of the Collector's reconstruction work, but the exact mechanism and continuity of the earlier body remain unspecified.
injury.onset_text: A scarred line beneath your left ribs tears open as the accumulated field strain catches you. Sol recognizes the location as part of the Collector's reconstruction work, but he cannot prove what the injury means. This is no simulation: your offense, defense, and recovery rhythm are now compromised.
injury.recovery_text: The injury will not vanish between rooms. Stabilize it, rest at safe points, use Sol's cover, and complete the next field milestones. It improves across levels 6-8 and is rehabilitated at level 9.

chosen_one.title: Hold the impossible line
chosen_one.objective: Use Second Wind under pressure, then keep Sol’s opening from becoming dependence.

messenger.title: Make the threat answer you
messenger.objective: Use Gravity of Voice to draw pressure away from Sol and control the exchange.

boss.title: Turn leverage into an opening
boss.objective: Use Call the Shot to create a decisive opening without surrendering the route.

fixer.title: Keep the deal alive
fixer.objective: Use Combat Stim to restore momentum and preserve the two-person formation.

zealot.title: Commit without going blind
zealot.objective: Use Committed Charge, then reassess before conviction becomes someone else’s control.

devout.title: Sustain the witness
devout.objective: Use Field Benediction to keep the patrol and its evidence moving.

protector.title: Balance force with restraint
protector.objective: Use Meteor Guard to absorb pressure without losing the people behind you.

guide.title: Restore the route
guide.objective: Use Balance Step to turn defense into a measured answer without overcommitting.

system.title: Read before you strike
system.objective: Use Exploit Window to expose the control pattern and attack the real weakness.

engineer.title: Repair under pressure
engineer.objective: Use Field Refit to restore what the fight is trying to take away.

infiltrator.title: Own the route
infiltrator.objective: Use Ghost Route to reposition before pressure closes, then let Sol hold the opening you create.

sniper.title: Choose one decisive line
sniper.objective: Use Measured Shot to remove the most dangerous opening with disciplined precision.

born_assassin.title: Break the center cleanly
born_assassin.objective: Use Disrupting Burst to end pressure before it spreads to the patrol.

soldier.title: Command a two-person formation
soldier.objective: Use Hold the Line to protect the route and give Sol room for an answering strike.

medic.title: Keep both fighters standing
medic.objective: Use Trauma Response to restore the formation without abandoning the objective.
